description: This file implements the NearestPointRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering a point with a specified radius and color using DirectX and Direct2D. It manages device-dependent resources such as brushes and handles drawing operations for rendering a point at a given location.

classes.name: NearestPointRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a point with specified properties (color and radius) using Direct2D.

methods.name: NearestPointRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with device resources and sets default properties.

methods.name: CreateDeviceDependentResources
methods.description: Creates device-dependent resources such as brushes.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Draws a point at the specified location.

methods.name: SetRadius
methods.description: Sets the radius of the point.

methods.name: SetColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the point.

methods.name: CreateBrush
methods.description: Creates a solid color brush with the current color.
